offering_description.value: Provides wireless phone service and wireline broadband, voice and video services to consumers and businesses, mainly in midsize, rural and small-town markets across the US. It sells service plans and devices through its own stores, online and retail partners, and builds and runs its own wireless and fiber networks.

primary_products.value: wireless phones and devices; fiber and copper broadband internet; home phone and video services

primary_services.value: wireless voice and data plans; business connectivity and networking; managed IT services

customer_segment.value: B2C: households and individual wireless subscribers in rural and midsize markets; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses needing connectivity and managed services; B2G: local government agencies and school districts

end_markets.value: telecommunications; consumer communications; small business connectivity; education and government

revenue_model.value: service fees: monthly wireless, broadband and phone service plans; product sales: smartphones and other devices sold to subscribers; project or contract: business network and managed service contracts
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells connectivity and voice, video and data services to end users and businesses; asset operator: owns and runs wireless networks, cell sites and fiber and copper networks; retailer: sells devices and plans through its own stores and retail channels

geography_served.value: US national: wireless across many midsize and rural markets in the US, wireline broadband in rural and small-town areas in several states

specialization.value: related lines: wireless service, wireline broadband and phone, and business connectivity

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail stores; online: websites and online ordering for plans and devices; third-party retail: authorized retail and carrier-partner stores; direct sales: sales staff serving business accounts
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licenses for wireless spectrum and state public utility commission oversight of local telephone service

notes: Wireless spectrum and tower sales announced by its wireless unit may change the business after completion.
